literature.attack: Simple Power Analysis Attack on SQIsign, IACR ePrint 2025/830, AFRICACRYPT 2025
literature.scope: preimplementation analysis of exponent randomization for the frozen Level-I Cornacchia route

inputs.blind_mapping: R is a uniform b-bit string and r=R+1, avoiding a zero blind without a rejection loop

algebra.secret_exponent_relation: e=(p+k1)/k2 for small public k1,k2 on the attacked Cornacchia square-root paths
algebra.correctness: for prime p and positive e, a^E mod p equals a^e mod p for every residue a, including zero
algebra.security_consequence: If SPA recovers E, the direct affine recovery of p is replaced by a structured factorization problem. The blind entropy is not itself a lower bound on attack work.
algebra.formation_leakage: Constructing r*(p-1) processes the same secret-derived p together with fresh r and is itself a power/EM surface. It must be included inside the threat model rather than placed outside the trigger and ignored.

multi_observation_gcd_attack.assumption: SPA recovers the exact independently blinded exponent from each observed modular-power call under one Tonelli-Shanks modulus; this model does not estimate that physical recovery probability.
multi_observation_gcd_attack.executed_structure: Each successful frozen square root performs at least one Legendre power followed by c=z^q, x=n^((q+1)/2), and t=n^q under the same p. The frozen 12-Sign corpus has pow_calls=legendre_calls+3*sqrt_calls=2180.
multi_observation_gcd_attack.transformation: For each recovered E_i compute N_i=k2_i*E_i-(k1_i+1)=t_i*(p-1), then take GCDs across calls sharing p.
multi_observation_gcd_attack.deterministic_blind_derivation: SHAKE256('sqisign-gcd-blind-v1:' || bits || fixture || trial || call-label), mapped to r=R+1; research model only
multi_observation_gcd_attack.interpretation: Under exact multi-call exponent recovery, fresh independent exponent blinding commonly makes p-1 the direct GCD regardless of whether the blind is 128 or 896 bits. This strengthens rejection of the standalone construction; it is not evidence that the current physical setup can recover those exponents.

interpretation.ecm_metric: log2 of the leading exp(sqrt(2*ln(q)*ln(ln(q)))) term for a q=2^b factor; this is a heuristic comparison proxy, not a concrete security estimate
interpretation.128_bit_blind: Rejected as a standalone 128-bit countermeasure: its factor-sized ECM proxy is only about 40.7 bits, and the exact blinded exponent retains the displayed factorization identity.
interpretation.896_bit_row: The leading-term proxy first exceeds 128 bits in this frozen candidate table, but this does not establish 128-bit security. Known structure in p-1, multiple traces, formation leakage and more specialized attacks remain unanalysed.
interpretation.performance: A 896-bit blind raises the fixed exponent schedule from 521 to 1408 rounds (2.7025x) and would consume about 20.35 KiB of fresh randomness per Sign on the frozen average 2180-pow/12-Sign corpus before RNG and formation costs.
interpretation.preferred_next_step: Run the preregistered analog attack first, including multi-call scoring grouped by modulus, then evaluate a reviewed masking/blinding construction with an explicit leakage model. Do not merge ad hoc exponent blinding based only on blind entropy or single-call analysis.

claim_boundary: This artifact checks algebraic correctness, exact width/randomness arithmetic, a reduced domain and the 16 public acquisition fixtures. It is not a cryptographic reduction, an ECM benchmark, a C implementation, a physical measurement or evidence that any blinding width is secure.
